keywords: About AIDEFEND AIDEFEND (AI Defense Framework) is an independent open-source knowledge base of defensive countermeasures for protecting AI and machine learning systems, created by Edward Lee (not affiliated with OWASP or MITRE). AIDEFEND answers "what defensive controls should exist" ; AITBM answers "how risky is this system."
